value.value: 2,458 applicants to 10 Early College High Schools in five states from 2005–06, 2006–07, and 2007–08 admissions cohorts: 1,044 offered enrollment and 1,414 not offered.

Admissions-lottery intent-to-treat evaluation of an offer of Early College enrollment versus no offer, with Year-10 postsecondary follow-up; the separate cost comparison covers six of the 10 sites and is a source-reported model.
